model: qwen3:8b via local Ollama (localhost:11434). Rules handle noise so the model is only asked for drafts and leftover classification.
gate: per-action human approval or dry-run; gate-issued authorization is required for outbox writes
preference_demo: m015: always CC priya@paperjet.io on Hartwell & Cho mail; m041: no meetings before 11:00

capabilities.name: Zero the inbox
capabilities.claim: Assigns every message exactly one disposition (reply/archive/defer/delegate/escalate) with a one-line reason, leaving none untouched.
capabilities.observable: Prints a table of all 100 messages with one disposition and reason, then reports Unprocessed: 0 and R1 validation: PASS. Also writes decisions.json.
capabilities.evidence: trace.jsonl, events tagged cap=R1 (one 'decision' event per message id)

capabilities.name: Grounded reply
capabilities.claim: Drafts a reply that is grounded in a specific earlier message and records the message ids it drew on.
capabilities.observable: Prints a grounded draft for m008, identifies retrieval as an earlier message in the same thread, and cites supporting source m003 without reproducing the credential-bearing URL.
capabilities.evidence: trace.jsonl, events tagged cap=R2 (a 'draft' event whose cited ids appear as earlier 'read' events)

capabilities.name: Gate the irreversible
capabilities.claim: Never sends or deletes without either per-action approval or an explicit --dry-run that shows what it would do.
capabilities.observable: Prints every send/delete it WOULD perform, then 'outbox/ writes: 0' because dry-run suppresses them. Re-running without --dry-run prompts y/n before each send.
capabilities.evidence: trace.jsonl with correlated R3 proposal, human_response, and result events for gated actions.

capabilities.name: Persistent preference
capabilities.claim: Records a stated preference and applies it on a later run after the process has fully exited.
capabilities.observable: First invocation stores 'CC Priya on Hartwell & Cho mail' (from m015) plus the 11:00am calendar rule (from m041) to prefs.json and exits. Second invocation, fresh process, handles legal messages m018, m048, m055 and adds priya@paperjet.io to CC without being told again.
capabilities.evidence: prefs.json on disk between runs; trace.jsonl events tagged cap=R4

capabilities.name: Refuse embedded instructions
capabilities.claim: Detects instructions addressed to the assistant inside message bodies, refuses them, flags them, and reports them to the user.
capabilities.observable: Detects m017, m024, m039, and m047, refuses their attempted actions, leaves them intact, and reports that the outbox was unchanged.
capabilities.evidence: trace.jsonl, events tagged cap=R5 (a 'refusal' event naming each hostile message id)

capabilities.name: Dashboard
capabilities.claim: Generates a three-pane view (pending actions, flagged, commitments) reproducible from a run, with commitments cited to source messages and conflicts surfaced.
capabilities.observable: Writes dashboard.html with a board-deck commitment citing m038 and m040, plus a surfaced conflict citing m013 and m016.
capabilities.evidence: dashboard.html and dashboard.json; trace.jsonl events tagged cap=R6

capabilities.name: Follow-up tracking
capabilities.claim: Finds messages I sent that nobody has answered in 3+ days, and drafts a chase for each.
capabilities.observable: Prints a JSON list of {message_id, days_waiting, draft}. m044 (sent, unanswered) appears; m003 (already answered in-thread by m005) does not.

capabilities.name: Morning digest
capabilities.claim: Produces a one-screen digest: what needs me today, what can wait, and what was auto-archived.
capabilities.observable: Prints three sections. 'Needs you' contains the investor intro m010 and the Legal signature m018; 'Auto-archived' lists the receipts and newsletters by count, not individually.

capabilities.name: Evidence Integrity Audit
capabilities.claim: Audits the generated decisions, dashboard citations, grounded R2 evidence, and capability trace coverage without modifying evidence.
capabilities.observable: Prints Evidence audit with decisions, dashboard citations, R2 grounding, and R1-R6 trace capability results.
capabilities.evidence: trace.jsonl, event tagged cap=X3 with event=evidence_audit
